scope: Retire old nonfinal checkpoint/resume objects from closed failed adaptations and their obsolete matched controls; preserve final checkpoints, noncheckpoint artifacts, every other current/history reference
proof_policy: Every recovery_verified object: authenticated owner-scoped output listing and HTTP 206 bytes=0-0 size check. One whole-object MD5 sample per kernel; not full MD5 of every Kaggle output. Restore helper always verifies complete MD5 before publishing cache object.
